item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Sleep. Your day is packed start to finish, so the wind-down window tonight is the part most likely to get squeezed. You've already got a relaxation block and a check-in scheduled ahead of a fixed bedtime — solid structure, but only if you actually honor it instead of letting one more task creep in. Action: when that wind-down block starts, phone and laptop go down, no exceptions.
